note: Verified by the owner. pixelPitchOptions currently has one confirmed configuration -- VideoSonic's standard 16:9 build (P3.9, 9 columns x 5 rows of 0.5m x 0.5m cabinets = 4.5m x 2.5m). Add further confirmed configurations (other pitches, aspect ratios, indoor/outdoor variants) as entries in the same shape when verified.
pitchOptionsNote: pitchOptions are STANDARD industry pixel-pitch categories offered in the calculator so users can model resolution at different pitches. Only P3.9 is VideoSonic's verified stock (standard:true); the others are general planning options, not a claim of inventory. pxPerPanel is the ACTUAL LED count per 500mm cabinet edge (the nominal pitch name is a rounded value, e.g. P2.9 is really 500/168 = 2.976mm = 168x168); resolution must use pxPerPanel, not 500/pitchMm. minViewingDistanceM uses the common 1mm-pitch-per-1m-distance rule of thumb.
